explanation: What 1930 ended was what 1889 began: an oligarchic republic in which the presidency passed between São Paulo and Minas Gerais by arrangement, and which the sources call a four-decade hegemony. Two things carried over from the proclamation and are the shape of 1930 as well — that the army makes and unmakes governments in Brazil, the Republic itself having been a bloodless military coup, and that the electorate was a census electorate. Vargas came in as the candidate who had lost the election.
